payload.body:
# Observation and Gram route archives with arithmetic-scope challenges

The archive retains the original three-channel coefficients, conditional ordinary mu and Lambda-minus-one prefix input, fixed versus growing gcd distinctions and finite short-filter argument. Round4 non-arithmetic Lambda models remain in their stated scope; round5 explains why the genuine convolution structure excludes those toys, without retracting the limited round4 proposition or proving H5.

This artifact-check review is inconclusive about mathematical validity. It preserves sources, their documented corrections and their limitations; it does not add a theorem, authenticate all upstream interfaces or supersede the existing RESULT.

- Short-sum S must include ordinary mu AND Lambda−1 over the specified starts and prefixes; bibliography alone is not inspection of the original theorem.
- Fixed smooth weights, M=2Y, H and L ranges, nonempty window and fixed/growing gcd constants are carried.
- Paid Fejer localization bounds a root-energy difference, not an unconditional energy-difference saving.
- The complete off-diagonal signed arithmetic Gram target, all cofactors and both parity channels remain unproved.
- Round5 preserves the scope of the earlier non-arithmetic countermodel; Lambda support and Lambda=mu*log exclude it as genuine arithmetic.
- Finite diagnostics and archival run outputs do not certify asymptotics or RH.

Confirmed self-owned text and data: CC BY 4.0. Code: Apache-2.0. Human contribution credit: Li Hongmin. AI roles are disclosed in RIGHTS-AND-ATTRIBUTION.json. Archived source or checkpoint permission wording describes a historical state; this edition has current publication authorization.
